subtitle: 國中程度引導式短文：回答三個問題，寫一位幫助過你的同學
task: Write a short passage of 60–100 words about a classmate who once helped you. Your passage should answer these questions: (1) Who is this classmate? (2) How did he or she help you? (3) How did you feel, and what did you do after that?
taskZh: 寫一篇 60–100 字的英文短文，介紹一位曾經幫助過你的同學。短文要回答三個問題：(1) 這位同學是誰？(2) 他／她怎麼幫助你？(3) 你當時有什麼感受？之後你做了什麼？
focus: 內容：三個問題都要回答到
文法：過去發生的事用過去式，動詞變化正確
連接詞：用 because、when、so 讓句子連貫
拼字與標點：句首大寫、句尾加句點

en: My classmate Kevin sits next to me in class. Last semester, I was sick for a week and missed many math lessons. When I came back to school, I felt worried because I did not understand the new lessons. Kevin lent me his notes and explained the hard parts to me after school. Thanks to his help, I got a good grade on the next test. I felt very thankful, so I bought him a cup of bubble tea. Now I also try to help others when they need it.
zh: 我的同學凱文上課時坐在我旁邊。上學期，我生病了一個星期，錯過了很多堂數學課。我回到學校時很擔心，因為我聽不懂新教的內容。凱文把他的筆記借給我，還在放學後教我比較難的部分。多虧他的幫忙，我下一次考試考得很好。我非常感謝他，所以請他喝了一杯珍珠奶茶。現在，別人需要幫忙時，我也會試著幫助他們。

patterns.zh: 說明某個時候的感受和原因
patterns.example: When I came back to school, I felt worried because I did not understand the new lessons.

patterns.pattern: lent me … and explained … to me
patterns.zh: 用 and 連接兩個幫忙的動作
patterns.example: Kevin lent me his notes and explained the hard parts to me after school.
Thanks to his help, I got a good grade on the next test.

patterns.zh: 先說感受，再用 so 說出因此做了什麼
patterns.example: I felt very thankful, so I bought him a cup of bubble tea.

parts: I was sick for a week.
combine.answer: I was sick for a week and missed many math lessons.

parts: I bought him a cup of bubble tea.
combine.answer: I felt very thankful, so I bought him a cup of bubble tea.

paraphrase.sentence: I got a good grade on the next test.
answers: I did well on the next test.
I got a high score on the next test.

paraphrase.sentence: I did not understand the new lessons.
answers: The new lessons were hard for me to understand.
I could not follow the new lessons.
